summary.text: Ernie Otten (Ernie Otten Jr. on Ballotpedia) is a Republican state senator from South Dakota's District 6 who returned to the Senate on January 14, 2025, after serving in the state House from 2021 to 2025.
He is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026; the June 2, 2026, Republican primary for the seat was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Otten's career experience, according to Ballotpedia, includes working in the home building industry and owning a business.
Ballotpedia lists him as having served in the state Senate for District 6 from 2013 to 2021 before his House service.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee and is vice chair of the Senate Government Operations and Audit Committee.
